game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Bramble Maze, a maze of brambles: the druid must handle wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Choreography: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat.
theme: Mystic Forest – Bramble Maze: a maze of brambles
core_gameplay_loop: In Bramble Maze, repeat each round: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat. Each round, wasp swarms strike the root gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the sync value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the root gate from wasp swarms in Bramble Maze: keep the sync meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: sync drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Loop Choreography
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Loop Choreography' (Week 5 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Bramble Maze'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sync changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against wasp swarms in Bramble Maze.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while sync > 0.
